title: fix: update deprecated OpenAI model and improve assistant error handling
body: ## Summary The default model `gpt-3.5-turbo-0613` has been deprecated and shut down by OpenAI, causing every assistant run to immediately enter the `failed` state — producing the `"Error: OpenAI assistant entered failed state"` error on chat start. **Changes:** - `Config.OPENAI_MODEL_ID` default: `gpt-3.5-turbo-0613` → `gpt-5.4-mini` - `_get_or_create_assistant()`: when loading a cached assistant, if `assistant.model != Config.OPENAI_MODEL_ID`, auto-update it via `assistants.update()` so stale `assistant_cache.json` entries don't keep using the old model - Run status polling: include `run_status.last_error.{code, message}` in both the log and the user-facing error string - Add `time.sleep(1)` in the `else` branch of the polling loop to avoid busy-waiting while the run is `in_progress`/`queued` Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/a68dc6e18d15481e8562a7ec3e1177f4 Requested by: @sachiniyer ---
